newsitem.title: USA: Amerchol builds polymer plant in China.
newsitem.headline: Amerchol builds polymer plant in China.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp said on Monday that its Amerchol Corp subsidiary is building a plant in China to produce Amerchol's line of polymers used in hair-care and other personal-care products.

The new plant, Amerchol's first in Asia, is located in China's southern Guangdong Province, and was set for completion in July 1997, Union Carbide said. The company said it decided to build the plant because of increasing world demand for cellulosic polymers.

The plant was a project of a Chinese equity joint venture, in which an affiliate of Amerchol held a majority interest, the company said. Amerchol's partner in the joint venture is Xiaolan Industrial Corp.
Amerchol also said it was adding technical sales personnel in China, with offices in Guangzhou and Shanghai, to support customers in the region.
This line of so-called UCARE Polymers is used in Asia in hair conditioning products and two-in-one shampoos, the company said.
